scripts.lint: uv run --project apps/story-engine --extra dev ruff check apps/story-engine/src apps/story-engine/tests
scripts.typecheck: uv run --project apps/story-engine --extra dev mypy --config-file apps/story-engine/pyproject.toml apps/story-engine/src/story_engine && pnpm --filter @story-engine/contracts typecheck
scripts.test: uv run --project apps/story-engine --extra dev pytest -c apps/story-engine/pyproject.toml apps/story-engine/tests
